policy.raster_source: direct contiguous render/crop from official 2022 PDF only; lossless encoding allowed; no redraw/reconstruction
policy.structured_source: tables/characteristics may be exact HTML structure when that improves interface; text/data must be source-exact and independently traceable
policy.crop_rule: one task/variant at a time; four-edge audit; never reuse a mechanical crop preset
policy.zoom_rule: large/dense graphs, plans, geometry and source tables require enlarge + zoom in/out/reset + mobile verification

build_rule: Final crop_px rectangles are not guessed here. They are created from fresh official-PDF renders during build, one item at a time, then passed through VISUAL_UI_CROP_GATE. A representation may change only after documented source/UI audit, never by copying another year's asset map.
